semantic.justification: Consumed ToIUri/UTF8 native escaped scalar algorithm, ASCII escape retention, uppercase invalid octets and non-ASCII scalar decoding. Ports only the consumed XML/package contract; native UNO services, general storage hierarchy, encrypted/ZIP64 packages, XLSB RecordParser and complete application document filters are outside this prerequisite. Strings/byte arrays and Promises bind host XML/ZIP transport; whole-module parity remains unverified.
